specs.note: Original passive RDMA responder design; superseded by spec-002. Not-implemented/drifted items below are expected by design except the stale self-annotations FR-014 and FR-015.

requirements.note: No inbound listener; component is outbound-only.
No protocol version handshake.
No session objects; outbound connections keyed by ip:port.
Reworked to outbound push; no 64-entry batch cap in code.
No batch-size cap enforced.
Credit-window post/reap loop, not a single-signaled serial write loop.
Carried forward as spec-002 FR-003.
Session close replaced by endpoint-keyed disconnect/disconnect_all.
QP-error/stall rebuild instead of session/CM-disconnect monitoring.
Resolution via IMemoryTier::peek, not a dispatch service.
ILogger used throughout; carried forward as spec-002 FR-010.
No standalone test-client binary; loopback_test is a hardware-gated integration test.
Only mock-transport tests exist; session/protocol/listener tests absent.
Stale annotation: claims telemetry not integrated, but it IS wired into ensure_connected/reap/recover/shutdown/Batch::finish.
Stale annotation: claims trait methods are NotInitialized stubs served via a serve module; methods are fully functional and no serve module exists.
No application wire protocol on this side; raw one-sided RDMA writes.
Network-isolation security; carried forward.
500us/64-entry latency target unmeasured; design changed.
No session model; 100-concurrent-sessions target N/A.
No test client.
No CM-disconnect event monitoring wired.
Superseded by spec-002 SC-004 (reframed criterion).
No handshake exists.
push_async enqueues and returns; one status/item in order.
Batch::drop reports; callback dropped on Err. Tests the_callback_fires_exactly_once, invalid_endpoint_drops_the_callback.
push is a blocking wrapper over push_async.
peek resolution; KeyNotFound / SizeMismatch before write.
RealConn::post_write into remote addr/rkey.
register_existing_mr of pool_info base+size per connection.
Table keyed by ip:port; per-host thread posts+reaps; lazy establish + reuse.
PUSH_WINDOW credits; successive_batches_overlap_on_the_wire test.
SUBMIT_QUEUE_DEPTH=256, MAX_TRACKED_BATCHES=64; a_full_submit_queue_fails_fast test.
recover() destroys QP first, one-repair budget, replays all batches; stall detection at check_stalled.
disconnect/disconnect_all join threads and report held batches.
parse_endpoint returns InvalidEndpoint.
NoopLogger fallback when logger receptacle unbound.
Feature-gated ZST-when-off; per-phase connect-latency breakdown; wired at connection.rs:1026.
No app auth by design; consistent with trusted fabric.
Extensive mock-transport + telemetry unit tests.
connect warm; idempotent; failed warm returns Ok with nothing cached; warm_connect_* tests.
set_local_peer_id stamps PeerId into private_data. Caveat: id is snapshotted at lazy table build; a call after first push/connect is silently ignored (spec's before-first-push guidance covers this).
statuses_mapped_in_order, done_items_are_never_posted.
a_full_submit_queue_fails_fast, teardown_reports_batches_it_still_holds, successive_batches_overlap_on_the_wire.
reused_connection_does_not_reconnect.
lost_writes_are_replayed / failing_again_after_the_reconnect_gives_up.
Criterion bench present; Cargo [[bench]] and README workflow exist.

Real-hardware, #[ignore]d end-to-end test with test-only rdma_cm responder scaffolding; not tied to any FR. Severity low.
Hardware measurement tool for the single-MR-vs-per-connection decision; no requirement behind it. Severity low.
